description: This is a server-side JavaScript source file (server.js) that sets up an express application to load environment variables, configure database connections for various database types (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB), and define API endpoints for database operations such as listing tables and retrieving data. It also includes classes implementing adapters for each database type and code for testing connections and handling API requests.

classes.name: DatabaseAdapter
classes.description: Abstract base class for database adapters, defining common interface methods such as testConnection, getTables, and getData.

classes.name: SQLAdapter
classes.description: Abstract class extending DatabaseAdapter, with implementations for executing SQL queries and methods for retrieving table information.

classes.name: PostgresAdapter
classes.description: Concrete adapter class for PostgreSQL, implementing execute, getTableQuery, and getDataQuery methods.

classes.name: MySQLAdapter
classes.description: Concrete adapter class for MySQL, implementing execute, getTableQuery, and getDataQuery methods.

classes.name: SQLiteAdapter
classes.description: Concrete adapter class for SQLite, implementing execute, getTableQuery, and getDataQuery methods.

classes.name: MongoDBAdapter
classes.description: Concrete adapter class for MongoDB, implementing connect, getTables, and getData methods.

methods.name: loadEnvFiles
methods.description: Reads environment variable files for different database configurations and merges them into process.env.

methods.name: testConnections
methods.description: Tests database connections for configured databases and reports success or failure.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Generic handler for database API endpoints, calling adapter methods and returning JSON responses.
